appSessions.label: Current app sessions
appSessions.description: Sign-in state used by the current version. This is core data.

browserProfiles.label: Current browser profiles

logs.label: Diagnostic logs

archivedLogs.label: Archived diagnostic logs
archivedLogs.description: Troubleshooting records no longer being written. Clearing them does not affect active operations.

imageCache.label: Image cache
imageCache.description: Cover and preview images that can be downloaded or generated again.
